source_requirement: Customers shall access Wearo from a mobile-friendly web experience without installing an app.
master_acceptance: A new user can start a supported try-on from a phone browser.
mvp_boundary: All source acceptance criteria apply for the supported pilot workflow.

source_requirement: Customers shall be able to explore using a guest session and optionally create a saved account.
master_acceptance: An invited or new shopper can preview without mandatory registration; saving prompts sign-in.
mvp_boundary: Guest may preview the flow; actual paid renders or persistent results require verified ownership.

source_requirement: Customers shall upload or capture their own photograph with clear positioning guidance.
master_acceptance: Photo can be supplied via camera or gallery; examples explain acceptable pose and framing.
mvp_boundary: All source acceptance criteria apply for the supported pilot workflow.

source_requirement: Wearo shall flag unusable photographs and explain how to retake them.
master_acceptance: Poor lighting, cropped body or multiple subjects receive actionable messages before a render is charged.
mvp_boundary: All source acceptance criteria apply for the supported pilot workflow.

source_requirement: Customers shall consent before a person photograph is processed and understand its intended use.
master_acceptance: Capture cannot proceed without an affirmative consent action and a clear notice.
mvp_boundary: All source acceptance criteria apply for the supported pilot workflow.

source_requirement: Customers who do not want to upload a personal photo shall be able to use an adult mannequin/model preview where supported.
master_acceptance: Selected designs can be explored without a real customer photograph.
mvp_boundary: Offer one adult neutral model for supported pilot garments/jewellery; no avatar customization.

source_requirement: Users shall view and manage their previously saved designs, looks and preferences.
master_acceptance: Saved content is accessible by its owner and may be edited or removed.
mvp_boundary: A basic recent-results list for signed-in users; no mood boards or saved styling preferences.

source_requirement: Customers shall access the product through accessible touch controls, readable text and clear error messages.
master_acceptance: Core upload, selection, approval and checkout handoff steps work without relying on color alone.
mvp_boundary: All source acceptance criteria apply for the supported pilot workflow.

source_requirement: Users shall select garments using an uploaded product image or a participating retailer catalog listing.
master_acceptance: Try-on starts from a valid garment photo or identifiable catalog product.
mvp_boundary: Support a single image upload or a small verified merchant catalog, not bulk supplier feeds.

source_requirement: Wearo shall support Western everyday garments: shirts, T-shirts, tops, jeans, trousers, skirts and dresses.
master_acceptance: Each supported clothing type can be selected and displayed in an appropriate visualization.
mvp_boundary: Pilot with shirts/T-shirts/tops only; jeans, trousers, skirts and dresses remain in the master backlog.

source_requirement: Wearo shall support key Indian garments: sarees, blouses, lehengas, kurtas and ethnic sets.
master_acceptance: Pilot catalog accepts these product categories with category-appropriate inputs.
mvp_boundary: Pilot with one or two quality-approved Indian categories (initially kurtas and a small curated saree selection); defer general coverage of blouses, lehengas and ethnic sets.

source_requirement: Product records shall retain the source image, product name, merchant/boutique and stated attributes.
master_acceptance: Every purchasable look can be traced to its exact item or clearly labelled concept.
mvp_boundary: For participating merchant items retain source photo, real merchant, item name/code and known details; nonmerchant user uploads are not purchasable.

source_requirement: Boutiques and retailers shall maintain product/design collections, prices and display availability.
master_acceptance: An authorized business user can add, revise or unpublish catalog items.
mvp_boundary: Merchant owner may add, update and unpublish 10-30 curated pilot products; no inventory synchronization or branches.

source_requirement: Product listings shall distinguish items for sale from illustrative AI styling suggestions.
master_acceptance: Users can tell which visualized items are actually available to buy or commission.
mvp_boundary: Show retailer-listed products as real catalog items; generated images are illustrative and cannot be treated as new purchasable SKUs.

source_requirement: A shopper shall generate a photo-based visualization of a selected outfit on their own image.
master_acceptance: A supported garment photo and person photo produce a clearly labelled AI preview.
mvp_boundary: All source acceptance criteria apply for the supported pilot workflow.

source_requirement: A result shall seek to preserve the customer’s face, skin tone, hair, apparent body proportions and background.
master_acceptance: Users can compare the preview with original and flag visible changes to their appearance.
mvp_boundary: Use a single front-facing portrait; review identity, skin tone, apparent proportions and background against original. Block obvious identity drift.

source_requirement: A result shall seek to preserve defining product attributes such as cut, color, print, border and motif.
master_acceptance: The visual review shows the same selected style and identifies obvious deviations.
mvp_boundary: Review garment colors/prints and key jewellery components before enabling that category/merchant.

source_requirement: The product shall display a clear statement that photo try-on is a visual preview, not a fit guarantee.
master_acceptance: The limitation is visible at result viewing and before fit-related decisions.
mvp_boundary: All source acceptance criteria apply for the supported pilot workflow.

source_requirement: Customers shall inspect their original photo alongside the generated preview.
master_acceptance: A before/after or side-by-side view is available for each completed render.
mvp_boundary: All source acceptance criteria apply for the supported pilot workflow.

source_requirement: Customers shall zoom into neckline, sleeves, drape, embroidery and jewellery details.
master_acceptance: A user can inspect supported high-resolution result details.
mvp_boundary: Zoom the delivered image and open the original product photo; no multi-angle inspection.

source_requirement: Customers shall regenerate a result or change the selected garment without taking another photo.
master_acceptance: The existing permitted person photo can be reused within the active session.
mvp_boundary: Allow retry / change item with same consented person photo; each new successful render follows disclosed price.

source_requirement: Customers shall be able to record whether a generated image resembles the garment and themselves.
master_acceptance: Simple feedback captures good result or reasons such as wrong face, color, neckline or drape.
mvp_boundary: One thumbs-up/down or short reasons picker attached to rendered preview; no advanced review workflow.

source_requirement: A failed or unsuitable generation shall offer a clear recovery action.
master_acceptance: The user can retry or correct an input; service-side failure does not consume a paid generation.
mvp_boundary: All source acceptance criteria apply for the supported pilot workflow.

source_requirement: The application shall present supported categories and combinations instead of implying every garment can be rendered accurately.
master_acceptance: Unsupported garments or accessories are disclosed before attempting a paid result.
mvp_boundary: Expose only item categories that pass the pilot quality gate; show unsupported categories before charging.

source_requirement: Customers shall preview gold and fashion necklaces, pendants, earrings and coordinated jewellery sets.
master_acceptance: A supported product may be visualized on an appropriate person reference.
mvp_boundary: Only necklaces/pendants and earrings (including simple paired sets). Rings, bangles and live AR are excluded.

source_requirement: Jewellery previews shall preserve the selected design, gold tone, stones and distinctive detailing.
master_acceptance: The result remains attributable to its selected product image and variant.
mvp_boundary: Must retain design, gold tone and recognizable stones sufficiently for a clearly illustrative product preview. If critical details change, do not market that product as supported.

source_requirement: Users shall see jewellery in proportion to the face, neckline or neck using declared dimensions where available.
master_acceptance: Scale is presented as approximate unless a supported calibration method was completed.
mvp_boundary: Use merchant-supplied dimensions where available and say scale is approximate; no calibrated fit or weight inference.

source_requirement: Users shall inspect jewellery close-ups and product details before enquiring or purchasing.
master_acceptance: A preview links to original seller images, item code and available specifications.
mvp_boundary: Always show original merchant item image and item name/code alongside the render.

source_requirement: Jewellery showrooms shall offer variants only when they correspond to actual catalog items.
master_acceptance: Selectable metal or stone variants link to their genuine products.
mvp_boundary: List only uploaded/confirmed real inventory designs; no imagined stone/metal variants.

source_requirement: Users shall send a shortlisted jewellery set to a showroom for an enquiry or appointment.
master_acceptance: The enquiry includes selected item details and customer-approved contact information.
mvp_boundary: A basic enquiry CTA sends the exact selected item and consented phone/contact to the merchant. No appointment booking engine.

source_requirement: An associate shall start a guided try-on session on a tablet or display.
master_acceptance: Staff can initiate a temporary customer session without creating a permanent public account.
mvp_boundary: Staff start a private, temporary session on a tablet or desktop. No dedicated smart mirror hardware.

source_requirement: A store session shall provide an obvious start, consent, capture, select, compare and finish flow.
master_acceptance: A first-time shopper can complete the session without lengthy staff instruction.
mvp_boundary: One linear flow: start -> consent -> photo -> select -> render -> review -> enquiry/finish.

source_requirement: Retailers shall offer an enquiry, stock-check or purchase handoff for selected items.
master_acceptance: The next action identifies the corresponding store product and destination.
mvp_boundary: A simple merchant enquiry/stock-check handoff; stock is not guaranteed in real time.

source_requirement: A public store display shall fully clear customer photos and outputs at session end or timeout.
master_acceptance: The next guest cannot recover or see the prior session.
mvp_boundary: End-session clears photos/results from the shared device and removes temporary session access; timeouts are configured.

source_requirement: A store manager shall see anonymized adoption and outcome reports for in-store try- ons.
master_acceptance: Reports show sessions, viewed products and voluntary purchase/enquiry handoffs.
mvp_boundary: A simple tenant summary: sessions, successful renders, selected items and opted-in enquiries. No branch-level analytics.

source_requirement: A customer shall open the exact participating seller product corresponding to a selected look.
master_acceptance: Every buy action is linked to a real product and selected variant.
mvp_boundary: Only where an exact seller URL exists; otherwise show an enquiry action rather than invented checkout.

source_requirement: A customer shall request an appointment, price quote or custom order from a boutique/showroom.
master_acceptance: Enquiries include explicitly selected items and consented contact method.
mvp_boundary: Send a selected item and contact request to the boutique or jeweller; deposits, quote engine and scheduling deferred.

source_requirement: A user shall receive useful confirmation after enquiry, approval, order or appointment handoff.
master_acceptance: A confirmation names the chosen item/project and the next expected action.
mvp_boundary: Show acknowledgement with selected item, recipient merchant and the next follow-up method.

source_requirement: All generated looks shall clearly indicate they are AI visualizations and may differ from the real item.
master_acceptance: Disclosure is shown on result views, shared previews and design exports.
mvp_boundary: All source acceptance criteria apply for the supported pilot workflow.

source_requirement: Wearo shall never state that a photo-only visualization establishes exact size, comfort or physical drape.
master_acceptance: Fit guidance is separately labelled with its measurement basis and limits.
mvp_boundary: All source acceptance criteria apply for the supported pilot workflow.

source_requirement: Customers shall control storage, deletion and sharing of their personal photos and generated looks.
master_acceptance: Delete and sharing controls are discoverable from the relevant content.
mvp_boundary: Minimal controls to avoid saving, delete owned results and decline sharing; permanent collections deferred.

source_requirement: Guest showroom sessions shall default to temporary image handling unless the customer actively saves.
master_acceptance: Ending or expiring a guest session removes the visible customer session.
mvp_boundary: Default business guest images are temporary and expire after session/retention policy; persistent saves need deliberate choice.

source_requirement: Users shall confirm they have permission to upload and transform photographs of the depicted people.
master_acceptance: The workflow rejects non-consensual impersonation and unsupported identity edits.
mvp_boundary: All source acceptance criteria apply for the supported pilot workflow.

source_requirement: The initial service shall clearly state its policy for underage users and photo submissions.
master_acceptance: Unsupported minor use is blocked or routed to an appropriate compliant guardian process.
mvp_boundary: All source acceptance criteria apply for the supported pilot workflow.

source_requirement: Only the customer and explicitly authorized boutique/retail staff shall access private project content.
master_acceptance: An unrelated shopper or business account cannot open another customer’s images.
mvp_boundary: All source acceptance criteria apply for the supported pilot workflow.

source_requirement: Customers shall be able to report inaccurate, harmful, inappropriate or unwanted results.
master_acceptance: Every displayed result exposes feedback/reporting and allows removal.
mvp_boundary: A simple report/remove result action plus manual moderation review of complaints.

source_requirement: A failed paid render shall not reduce the customer’s usable credit balance.
master_acceptance: A user sees the corrected usage balance or automatic credit reversal.
mvp_boundary: All source acceptance criteria apply for the supported pilot workflow.

source_requirement: Users and businesses shall see their plan, used credits and remaining preview allowance.
master_acceptance: Usage is understandable before and after a billable visualization.
mvp_boundary: Show current balance, action price and recent token use. No subscription tiers or elaborate plan management.

source_requirement: Customers shall be informed whether their submitted photographs are retained or used to improve models.
master_acceptance: Retention and training choices are visible and are not silently opted in.
mvp_boundary: Explicit explanation of data retention and no default use for training; do not implement training opt-in during MVP.

source_requirement: One Wearo account and common platform shall support Wearo Shop, Wearo Studio, Wearo Mirror and future branded offerings.
master_acceptance: All enabled offerings are accessible under one platform identity and common business rules without separate billing systems.
mvp_boundary: One Wearo brand/platform and wallet/identity rules; only Shop-style consumer try-on and a merchant-assisted Mirror-lite experience are enabled. Full Studio and physical Mirror deferred.

source_requirement: The same platform shall serve individual B2C customers and business B2B customers with audience-specific experiences.
master_acceptance: Consumer mobile and business workspace present appropriate navigation, screens and permissions.
mvp_boundary: Distinct consumer phone layout and business owner/associate workspace; not a full enterprise UI.

source_requirement: Offerings shall adapt to phone, tablet, desktop and showroom display form factors as appropriate.
master_acceptance: Core workflows remain usable and accessible on each supported device class.
mvp_boundary: Responsive mobile, tablet and desktop browsers. Dedicated large-format mirrored display experience is excluded.

source_requirement: Users shall see only offerings and features enabled for their account, organization or plan.
master_acceptance: Unentitled features cannot be opened or charged; upgrading exposes eligible options.
mvp_boundary: Only categories and merchant features explicitly enabled for the account or pilot tenant appear.

source_requirement: B2C shall support mobile-number login and sign-up using one-time passwords (OTP).
master_acceptance: Valid OTP completes sign-in; invalid/expired codes are rejected; no password is required.
mvp_boundary: All source acceptance criteria apply for the supported pilot workflow.

source_requirement: OTP entry shall include expiry, resend limits, retry controls and clear failure messages.
master_acceptance: Abusive requests are rate-limited and legitimate customers can safely retry.
mvp_boundary: All source acceptance criteria apply for the supported pilot workflow.

source_requirement: Guest product exploration may be allowed, but paid actions and saved assets require verified account ownership.
master_acceptance: Guest cannot access paid credit wallet or persistent private designs without verification.
mvp_boundary: Guest browsing only; OTP is needed before wallet top-up, paid renders or saved results.

source_requirement: A business can self-register through a guided, minimal business onboarding form.
master_acceptance: Business can create a tenant and begin eligible activities without manual Wearo intervention.
mvp_boundary: Guided self-sign-up for one business/store; Wearo team may assist pilot onboarding without replacing self-serve flow.

source_requirement: Business onboarding shall capture only required identity, contact, billing address, and relevant tax invoicing fields.
master_acceptance: Required fields reflect jurisdiction and invoice needs; unnecessary business information is optional.
mvp_boundary: Collect only identity, email/phone contact, state, billing address and tax fields needed for invoicing.

source_requirement: Indian businesses shall be able to enter GSTIN when applicable, legal/trade name, billing address and state.
master_acceptance: Invoice data can be reviewed before checkout; GSTIN is optional where legally not applicable.
mvp_boundary: GSTIN is optional if not applicable; Indian state/address and invoice details recorded.

source_requirement: Businesses shall choose business type such as boutique, clothing retailer, jewellery retailer or enterprise chain.
master_acceptance: Onboarding labels and recommended offerings align with selected business type.
mvp_boundary: Pilot business types: boutique and gold jeweller. Chain/multi-outlet onboarding deferred.

source_requirement: B2B users shall sign in with verified email and email OTP.
master_acceptance: Email verification opens only permitted organization workspaces and an expired OTP is rejected.
mvp_boundary: All source acceptance criteria apply for the supported pilot workflow.

source_requirement: Business owner shall invite and remove staff and grant role-based access.
master_acceptance: Staff see only functions allowed by owner/admin/stylist/cashier/viewer role.
mvp_boundary: Owner can invite/revoke an associate. Limit permissions to owner and associate in the pilot.

source_requirement: Platform shall isolate every business tenant’s customers, photos, designs, catalogues, usage, balances and invoices.
master_acceptance: Staff of tenant A cannot discover, search, view, modify or charge tenant B data.
mvp_boundary: All source acceptance criteria apply for the supported pilot workflow.

source_requirement: All actions and credits shall be attributable to a consumer account or selected business tenant.
master_acceptance: Every completed action is recorded under exactly one paying account context.
mvp_boundary: All source acceptance criteria apply for the supported pilot workflow.

source_requirement: One common prepaid Wearo Token wallet and pricing policy shall serve both B2C and B2B accounts.
master_acceptance: Both can buy, spend and review Wearo Tokens; tenant and personal balances remain independent.
mvp_boundary: All source acceptance criteria apply for the supported pilot workflow.

source_requirement: Before a paid action, the platform shall show its Wearo Token price and available balance.
master_acceptance: User can approve or decline and is not unexpectedly charged.
mvp_boundary: Display fixed token price of each supported render before user confirms; no variable surprise debits.

source_requirement: Wearo Tokens shall reflect published per-action consumption rates, not imply that every image model bills by native text tokens.
master_acceptance: Pricing schedule explains costs for try-on, image variants, 3D previews and other billable actions.
mvp_boundary: Publish simple action prices (e.g., one garment render, one jewellery render, additional successful render). These are Wearo billing units, not model API input tokens.

source_requirement: Every billable request shall debit the correct wallet only once and generate an itemized usage record.
master_acceptance: Duplicate submissions, retries or refreshes cannot create duplicate charges for one transaction.
mvp_boundary: All source acceptance criteria apply for the supported pilot workflow.

source_requirement: Failed, cancelled-before-processing or non-delivered actions shall follow a clearly stated refund/recredit policy.
master_acceptance: Automatically eligible reversals restore balance and appear in transaction history.
mvp_boundary: All source acceptance criteria apply for the supported pilot workflow.

source_requirement: Both consumers and businesses shall purchase Wearo Tokens through prepaid top-up packs.
master_acceptance: Successful top-up immediately updates the correct wallet and issues payment confirmation.
mvp_boundary: One-step prepaid purchase by the logged-in consumer or merchant owner; top-up balance refresh confirmed by payment provider.

source_requirement: Larger prepaid token packs shall support transparent volume discounts for both B2B and B2C.
master_acceptance: Checkout shows base price, discount, final price and tokens credited before payment.
mvp_boundary: Show a standard pack and a larger discounted pack for BOTH segments; no negotiated enterprise plans.

source_requirement: Wallet shall show token purchases, promotional credits, consumption, refunds and expiry, if any.
master_acceptance: Balances reconcile with a downloadable and filterable transaction history.
mvp_boundary: A basic wallet history of top-ups, successful render debits and refunds. Export and elaborate filters deferred.

source_requirement: Users shall receive configurable low-balance alerts and insufficient-balance guidance.
master_acceptance: Actions requiring more tokens than available cannot start without an approved funding method.
mvp_boundary: Insufficient-balance warning links to a top-up pack. Configurable alert subscriptions are deferred.

source_requirement: The platform shall distinguish promotional tokens from purchased tokens and state any validity rules upfront.
master_acceptance: Consumption order and expiry date, if applied, are visible before purchase/use.
mvp_boundary: Permit one clearly marked promotional first-preview credit per verified B2C user; show its value/expiry and separate it from paid tokens. Additional promotions are deferred.

source_requirement: A payment gateway shall support secure prepaid top-ups and issue usable payment receipts.
master_acceptance: Gateway-confirmed payment credits tokens once and unsuccessful payment does not credit them.
mvp_boundary: All source acceptance criteria apply for the supported pilot workflow.

source_requirement: Payment flow shall support India-relevant options such as UPI, cards and net banking where offered by the gateway.
master_acceptance: Users can select available supported methods and view payment result.
mvp_boundary: Use available Indian gateway methods (particularly UPI and cards); do not promise every rail until enabled by the gateway.

source_requirement: Business purchases shall generate invoices with applicable tax details, numbering, date and legally required fields.
master_acceptance: Invoice can be downloaded and reflects the correct business and transaction.
mvp_boundary: All source acceptance criteria apply for the supported pilot workflow.

source_requirement: Payment refunds, failed payments and reconciliation discrepancies shall have traceable statuses.
master_acceptance: Wallet, invoice and payment status remain consistent after a correction.
mvp_boundary: Track payment success/failure/refunds and resolve reconciliation discrepancies manually if needed.

source_requirement: Wearo platform administrators shall have a separate username/password login, with mandatory multi-factor authentication.
master_acceptance: Consumer/B2B login does not grant admin access; admin account requires second factor.
mvp_boundary: All source acceptance criteria apply for the supported pilot workflow.

source_requirement: Wearo admin dashboard shall summarize customers, tenants, active users, revenue, token sales, token use, failed jobs and model spend.
master_acceptance: Metrics can be filtered by period, offering and B2B/B2C segment.
mvp_boundary: Core dashboard: signed-up users, onboarded merchants, completed/failed renders, revenue, tokens purchased/spent and model cost; segment filters.

source_requirement: Authorized admins shall manage account/tenant status, offering entitlements and restrictions.
master_acceptance: Admin can activate, suspend or restore permitted accounts with reason and audit trail.
mvp_boundary: All source acceptance criteria apply for the supported pilot workflow.

source_requirement: Wearo admins shall manage master token packs, pricing, discount tiers and promotions.
master_acceptance: Published changes appear in checkout with effective dates and price history.
mvp_boundary: Admin can edit pilot token pack definitions and discount tiers with effective dates. Advanced promotions deferred.

source_requirement: Authorized AI admins shall choose approved models for each use case and supported offering.
master_acceptance: Model selection can be updated for future requests with a traceable change record.
mvp_boundary: Choose an approved active model per supported garment or jewellery render use case. No automatic optimizer.

source_requirement: Admin shall register model versions, capability, operating status and allowed customer segments.
master_acceptance: Unavailable or disabled models cannot be used for new processing jobs.
mvp_boundary: Track approved model version, capabilities and status; prevent disabled models for new requests.

source_requirement: Customer and business photos shall be private, consent-based and governed by visible retention/deletion options.
master_acceptance: No private photo is visible to another account or used in training without appropriate permission.
mvp_boundary: All source acceptance criteria apply for the supported pilot workflow.

source_requirement: Platform shall support data access, export, correction and deletion request workflows as applicable.
master_acceptance: A user can submit a request and track its disposition within published policy timelines.
mvp_boundary: Provide request submission and traceable manual fulfilment for access, correction, export and deletion; no fully automated self-service workflow.

source_requirement: Sensitive actions such as admin login, price changes, wallet adjustments, tenant access and model changes shall be audited.
master_acceptance: Log records actor, action, timestamp, entity and reason, with access controls.
mvp_boundary: All source acceptance criteria apply for the supported pilot workflow.

source_requirement: The platform shall publish service status and provide clear progress, retry and incident messages.
master_acceptance: Customers can see whether a job is pending, processing, completed or failed.
mvp_boundary: Per-render progress and clear failure/retry messages; full public service-status portal deferred.

source_requirement: Administrators shall detect unusual wallet use, suspicious sign-in and automated abuse patterns.
master_acceptance: Suspicious activity generates actionable review or protective limits.
mvp_boundary: OTP throttling, request limits, anomaly review for duplicate/abusive spends. Sophisticated fraud analytics deferred.

source_requirement: Platform shall allow customers to submit a support issue, billing dispute or render-quality complaint.
master_acceptance: Ticket includes case status and resolution; adjustment is recorded if granted.
mvp_boundary: A simple issue/dispute/report form with internal reference/status and customer follow-up; not a complex ticketing portal.
